ms.promise: Field Survey of available governance frameworks in Management, Manufacturing, and Information Technology presented in PDF format. We will begin by performing an information gathering session and report on the current state of available governance frameworks from management, manufacturing, and information technology organizations.
ms.criteria: view the field survey as a PDF document, with proper licensing (CC BY 4.0 DEED) https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
ms.report:
Our goal was to provide a Field Survey of available governance frameworks in Management, Manufacturing, and Information Technology presented in PDF format. We will begin by performing an information gathering session and report on the current state of available governance frameworks from management, manufacturing, and information technology organizations. 

This work is completed. Please see the finished document here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DaQsGG8ZpZvFtbtuX4kshlAKJtp1vsOx/view?usp=sharing
The work is a 42 page pdf document which surveys existing governance systems. It is licensed as CC by 4.0 and represents the completion of milestone 1.

ms.report:
For Milestone 3, we needed to socialize the work from the internal workshops to the broader community. We did this with Twitter Spaces, Discord Town Halls, and a Catalyst After Town Hall Breakout Room. We received feedback from milestone reviewers that more detailed information was needed. We recreated the video with feedback from each session. We were able to recover recordings from sessions with technical difficulties as well.
The announcement for the workshops is here: https://twitter.com/AdosiaIO/status/1747003246340608503
The Drive with the recordings is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OarQf2Y5fF-AeoZb76N-qIvSBTjzpTsr?usp=drive_link
The improved YouTube Video is located here: https://youtu.be/JeQeiYf6gRA
